$comment: Facet spacing, layout, radius, stroke and touch tokens: the single source for the WASM renderer and the panel firmware (tools/gen_space.mjs -> space_gen.h: fw::sp::, fw::lay::, fw::rad::, fw::stroke::, fw::touch::). Values are device px. The top level of each token is the 720 x 720 reference panel (1.5x, 8 px grid) = Facet main packages/tokens/src/tokens.json; "1x" = the 480 x 480 panels (4 px grid). 1x source per group in `groups[].source1x`: layout + touch = the docs density.1x table, space + radius = reference x 2/3 snapped to the 4 px grid (nearest, minimum 4); strokes 1-2 px kept, >= 3 px x 2/3 to the nearest even (Darren 2026-10-21: multiples of 4, no odd numbers). dp = px / density.

grid.about: Every x, y, width and height on a screen is a multiple of the grid.
grid.rule: Every spacing, layout, radius and touch value is a multiple of 4 px at both densities (Darren 2026-10-21; minimum 4 when non-zero, radius 0 = square, radius round = sentinel). Strokes: 1 and 2 px hairlines allowed, 3 px and up even. A 720 value that is an approved docs value on the 2 px grid only carries `grid2` (the reason) until Darren decides. tools/gen_space.mjs fails the build on any other value.

groups.label: Spacing scale
groups.source1x: rule: x 2/3 snapped to the 4 px grid (no docs 1x table)
groups.about: Steps inside components: padding and gaps. Pick the step, never a literal.

groups.label: Screen layout
groups.source1x: docs density.1x layout, snapped to the 4 px grid (gutter 16 so 2 cards and 3 tiles fill 480 exactly)
groups.about: One inset on every side, more space between groups than inside them, rows separated by hairlines rather than boxes.

groups.label: Radius
groups.source1x: rule: x 2/3 snapped to the 4 px grid (no docs 1x table)
groups.about: Cards and tiles are square (rows and surfaces, not bubbles); controls round a little; chips, pills and knobs are fully round.

groups.label: Strokes and borders
groups.source1x: rule: 1-2 px kept, >= 3 px x 2/3 to the nearest even
groups.about: Hairlines separate, edges outline, arcs and indicators carry a value.

groups.label: Touch targets
groups.about: Hit areas are at least touch-min on both axes, even when the drawn control is smaller; the standard target is touch.

card-h.use: Home card height (2 rows per view: 2 x card-h + gutter = content height at both densities; 1x 184 not 188 so 480 fits exactly)

list-row-h.use: List row height (docs layout sheet-row-h: settings, picker and sheet rows); one line or title + sub line

dial-scale.use: Dial: the square of the tick scale (docs size dial-scale 560; 1x = x 2/3 to an 8 px multiple so the centre lands on the grid)

dial-arc.use: Dial: the value arc square, centred in the scale (docs size dial-arc 432; 1x = x 2/3)

dial-knob.use: Dial: knob diameter incl. its canvas ring (docs 26 = 2 x (11 + 4 / 2), onto the 4 px grid)

dial-tick.use: Dial scale: minor tick length, drawn inward from the scale edge (docs 10, onto the grid)

dial-tick-major.use: Dial scale: major (labelled) tick length (docs 18, onto the grid)

dial-toggle-w.use: Dial: width of the centre ON / OFF button (docs size dial-toggle-w 128; 1x 88 keeps it centred on the grid)

dot.use: Status dot diameter (docs size dot 8; docs 1x 6 is off the grid -> 4, = Card's dot)

chip-h.use: Status chip height (docs size chip-h 32; docs 1x 20 -> 24 so the 16 px caps-sm box centres on the grid)

badge-h.use: Count badge height = its minimum width (one digit = a circle; docs size badge-h 32, 1x = chip-h)

section-h.use: Section header height (docs size section-h 48; 1x x 2/3); = touch min, so a header action is a full-height target

ibtn-play.use: Icon button play: round accent button diameter (docs size icon-play 96, 1x 64); glyph ic::feature

ibtn-round.use: Icon button round: diameter (docs size icon-round 80, 1x 52); glyph ic::glyph

ibtn-square.use: Icon button square: side (docs size icon-square 48, 1x 32 = touch min); glyph ic::glyph

corner-tick.use: Corner ticks: length of each L (docs btn-tick-len 8; 1x = space 2); fw::corner_ticks default

radio.use: Radio: outer diameter incl. its stroke edge ring (docs size radio 24; docs 1x keeps 24, x 2/3 = 16 like ic::icon so it matches the row icons)

radio-dot.use: Radio: the selected dot (docs size dot 8; docs 1x 6 is off the grid; 8 centres on the grid in 24 and 16)

swatch.use: Accent swatches: one round target incl. the stroke edge selection ring on its edge (docs .f-sw 48; 1x 40 not x 2/3 = 32 so the dot keeps the 720 look: 8 in, 6 clear of the ring)

swatch-dot.use: Accent swatches: the accent dot, centred in the swatch ((swatch - dot) / 2 = 8 at both densities, on the grid; docs .f-sw i 32)

speaker-btn-h.use: Speaker button height (docs size speaker-btn-h 48, 1x 32 = touch min, fits the header row)

speaker-btn-max.use: Speaker button: widest the name may get before it ellipsises (docs size speaker-btn-max)

toast-icon.use: Toast: the tone-tinted icon square (docs size toast-icon 48, 1x x 2/3), centred in toast-h; glyph icon 32 / 20 centred in it (480: 6 px in, the same open point as the square Icon button: a centred 20 px glyph and a centred square cannot both sit on the 4 px grid in an 80 px toast)

round.use: pills, knobs, dots (fully round; 999 = sentinel, not a length)

corner-tick.use: Corner ticks: width of each L (docs btn-tick-thick 2)

min.use: smallest hit area on either axis

columns.about: Home: 2 columns of card-w with gutter between, inset outside (32 + 320 + 16 + 320 + 32 = 720; 20 + 212 + 16 + 212 + 20 = 480). Tiles: 3 columns of tile-w (32 + 3 x 208 + 2 x 16 + 32 = 720; 20 + 3 x 136 + 2 x 16 + 20 = 480).
